AI Security Analyst, Infrastructure
As an AI Security Analyst specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations and help estimate delivery work.
Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
Own an infrastructure workstream, manage dependencies and milestones, and provide day-to-day guidance to consultants.
Qualifications
Required:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field.
2+ years of combined cybersecurity and AI engineering experience, including hands-on production work in both domains.
Hands-on experience designing, integrating and securing production generative AI, RAG or agentic workloads.
Hands-on depth in AWS, Azure or Google Cloud. Kubernetes or container platforms. Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, policy-as-code.
Ability to build infrastructure automation using Python, Go, Bash, PowerShell, Git and CI/CD tooling.
Preferred: Familiarity with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or MLflow. Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CKA, CKS.
